description: Review & approve: take a HALTED or PAUSED crew's already-open pull request through the specialist reviews to the approve & merge gate, without re-running the Engineer. Omit prUrl to use the PR stored on the crew. A merged PR is refused. Requires `approve` scope.

prUrl.description: https://github.com/{owner}/{repo}/pull/{n} in the crew's repository, when the crew has none on record.

name: anyforge_resume_crew_with_pr
title: Resume crew with pr
